```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```



```{r}
library(harmony)
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(cowplot)
library(Matrix)
library(ggplot2)
options(bitmapType = "cairo")

```


#read full reg obj data
```{r}


HH30F <- readRDS("/nobackup/proj/comet_icnlmdhuc/Taran/chicken_RNA_seq/HH30/HH30F/sObj/sObj_7_reg_diff.RDS")
HH30G <- readRDS("/nobackup/proj/comet_icnlmdhuc/Taran/chicken_RNA_seq/HH30/HH30G/sObj/sObj_7_reg_diff.RDS")
HH30H <- readRDS("/nobackup/proj/comet_icnlmdhuc/Taran/chicken_RNA_seq/HH30/HH30H/sObj/sObj_7_reg_diff.RDS")
HH30T <- readRDS("/nobackup/proj/comet_icnlmdhuc/Taran/chicken_RNA_seq/HH30/HH30T/sObj/sObj_7_reg_diff.RDS")

```

#set orig.ident so Harmony has something to integrate over
```{r}

HH30F$orig.ident <- "HH30F"
HH30G$orig.ident <- "HH30G"
HH30H$orig.ident <- "HH30H"
HH30T$orig.ident <- "HH30T"
```

#merge into one object
```{r}

HH30 <- merge(HH30F, y = list (HH30G, HH30H, HH30T))

```


#pre-processing
```{r}
HH30 <- NormalizeData(HH30)
HH30 <- FindVariableFeatures(HH30, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
HH30 <- ScaleData(HH30, vars.to.regress = "CC.Difference", features = VariableFeatures(HH30)) #regression diff
HH30 <- RunPCA(HH30, features = VariableFeatures(HH30), npcs = 50)

```


# Integrate over a single batch variable
```{r}
HH30 <- RunHarmony(
  object         = HH30,
  group.by.vars  = "orig.ident",        # or e.g. "batch", "donor"
  reduction.use  = "pca",
  dims.use       = 1:30,                # choose PCs to harmonize
  reduction.save = "harmony",
  project.dim    = TRUE
)

```



# UMAP
```{r}
HH30 <- RunUMAP(HH30, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30)

# Nearest neighbours and clustering
HH30 <- FindNeighbors(HH30, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30)
HH30 <- FindClusters(HH30, resolution = c(0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7))

```

#UMAP trial
```{r}

res <- "RNA_snn_res."
nums = c(0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7)
paste0(res, nums)

DimPlot(HH30, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, repel = TRUE, group.by = paste0(res, nums), pt.size = 0.5)
ggsave("/nobackup/proj/comet_icnlmdhuc/Taran/chicken_RNA_seq/HH30/integration/diff-reg/plots/reg-diff-int-30-umap-trial.png", dpi = 400, width =60, height = 35, units = "cm")

```


#plot UMAP
```{r}

DimPlot(HH30, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, repel = TRUE, group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.7", pt.size = 0.5)
ggsave("/nobackup/proj/comet_icnlmdhuc/Taran/chicken_RNA_seq/HH30/integration/diff-reg/plots/reg-diff-int-30-0.6.png", dpi = 400, width =60, height = 35, units = "cm")

```

## TSNE dimensionality reduction
```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=2.5, fig.align="center", fig.cap="t-SNE Visualization of harmony embeddings"}h
HH30 <- HH30 %>%
    RunTSNE(reduction = "harmony")

```

```{r}h

DimPlot(HH30, reduction = "tsne", label = TRUE, pt.size = .1)



```

```{r}

saveRDS(HH30, file = "/nobackup/proj/comet_icnlmdhuc/Taran/chicken_RNA_seq/HH30/integration/diff-reg/sObj/sObj_HH30-diff-int.RDS")

```
